LanguageData.VT_Settings_TipNote: Note: Hover over a setting name to see a tooltip with details.
LanguageData.VT_ShockwaveSpeed_Tooltip: How many cells the shockwave expands in one second.
LanguageData.VT_FireStartChance_Tooltip: Chance to leave flickering flames in an affected cell. They are visual only: real fires can not burn while the game is paused during takeoff.
LanguageData.VT_ExplosionChance_Tooltip: Chance to show a small explosion in an affected cell.
LanguageData.VT_VisualsFleckChance_Tooltip: Chance of a flash on each cell the ring passes. Lower makes the ring sparser and a bit lighter on the computer.
LanguageData.VT_RemoveGrass_Tooltip: Removes plants and grass in affected cells. Can significantly slow down in lush biomes.
LanguageData.VT_DestroyBuildings_Tooltip: Destroy furniture, fences, workbenches and everything else that can not support roof. Destroying this kind of things do not affect performance significantly.
LanguageData.VT_DestroyRoofholders_Tooltip: Also destroy roof-holding objects like walls or pillars. This usually triggers roof collapse calculations and slows the animation.
LanguageData.VT_AffectTerrain_Tooltip: Removes floors or bridges, destroys orbital platforms.
LanguageData.VT_Mode_Label: What the shockwave does to the map:
LanguageData.VT_Mode_Destroy_Tooltip: Really destroys things and floors in the shockwave's path, per the toggles below. Most expensive on dense bases.
LanguageData.VT_Mode_Scorch_Tooltip: Nothing is destroyed: the swept ground is painted over with scorched earth and ash, hiding everything under it. Costs almost nothing however crowded the map is. Pawns can still be killed.
LanguageData.VT_Mode_EffectsOnly_Tooltip: Flashes, dust, flames and explosions only; the map is left as is.
LanguageData.VT_FrameBudget_Tooltip: Destruction runs in 15 steps per second; this is how long each step may take. The visible ring never runs ahead of destruction: where there is more to destroy than fits, the whole wave slows down smoothly instead of stuttering. Lower keeps frames smooth, higher keeps the wave fast.
LanguageData.VT_SkipFilthFloors_Tooltip: Do not remove floors that have filth on them. Removing such a floor also destroys the filth, which costs as much as destroying an object.
LanguageData.VT_Section_Performance: Performance (these noticeably change how heavy the takeoff is)
LanguageData.VT_DevModeNote: Many more look settings (colors, brightness, sizes, timings) appear here with Development mode on.
